versions.changelog:
Initial release of npc-distill:  
- Enables building local digital personas of specific individuals for practice, drafting, and decision simulation.  
- Supports ingesting text, URLs, or user intentions (e.g., “练习汇报”, “模拟 NPC 反应”) to trigger actions.  
- All data stored locally using anonymized codes (L001/L002), prioritizing privacy and open-source scenarios.  
- Provides 5 core workflows: text ingestion, URL ingestion, pressure testing, dialogue rehearsal, and stylized drafting.  
- Compatible with Claude Skills, Hermes Agent, LobsterAI, OpenClaw, and other agentskills.io-compliant platforms.  
- Comprehensive troubleshooting and known limitations documented for user reference.
